title: 1923 Prairie: the Kellogg house stands
items: The Kellogg house at 1923 Prairie Avenue is no longer a plain draft block: two storeys of brick over a high basement under a crested mansard, a canted bay at the north corner rising past the cornice under its own crown, hooded windows, a columned porch over a broad high stoop and iron fences either side of the walk, built from the Chicago Tribune's 1898 sketch of its front and a row drawing of the block's fronts, on the 1911 map's plan.
Still to come: the porch's arch, the stoop's sweeping stone cheeks and the scroll-panel fence the 1898 sketch draws.
